description: This source file contains a suite of unit tests for a device management and provisioning system, using Google Test framework. It tests various components like XRFCStore, XBSStore, hostIf_DeviceInfo, and request handling functions. The tests cover setting and getting configuration parameters, handling of device information, file-based parameter storage, and notification functionalities. It includes test cases for parsing JSON requests, handling file removal, reading/writing configuration files, and invoking device info interface methods.
